settings.content: Only Shopify-defined category metafields for Color contain a swatch. To show swatches for custom metafields, enter their names here.

settings.label: Custom swatch group names
settings.info: Use a comma separated list. Limitation: custom swatches, including sibling swatches, are capped at 20 by Shopify.

settings.label: Parallax strength
settings.info: Also set in pro-banner background blocks.

settings.content: Negative values animate background images in the same direction as the scroll direction.
Positive values animate background images opposite to the scroll direction.
A value of 0 disables the parallax effect, preventing landscape-orientation images from being zoomed to support the parallax animation.
These settings are intended for agencies and advanced users. Nothing here is required to launch your store.
All of these features are disabled by default. Entering a metafield name enables these features.

settings.label: Product preorder
settings.info: [One] True or False

settings.content: Shows `Pre-order` on the add-to-cart button and 'Sale type: Pre-order' to the cart line item. Both labels can be adjusted in your theme translations.

settings.label: Product upsell list
settings.info: [One] List of products

settings.content: Switches the cart upsell block to prioritize lists of products that are relevant to what is currently in the cart.

settings.label: Badges
settings.info: [One] Single line text - or - [List] Single line text

settings.content: Add custom badges to product cards. If you've set up color swatches and want color-specific badges, you can set this key-value pair as a variant metafield to add color-specific badges.

settings.label: Line item property value
settings.info: [One] Single line text

settings.content: Show extra detail on cart line items, like the color name for sibling products. The property label defaults to 'Color' and can be changed in theme translations under 'product.line_item_property.label'.
Display additional product information like the fit, brand, sibling color, or additional sale information.
Valid inputs for card content slots:
[One] Multi line text — assumed to contain HTML and will be unescaped and unstyled to support advanced use cases
[One] Single line text — styled to match surrounding product card text
[One] Rich text — allows basic styling control with heading, bold, and italic tags
Sibling products are a way to split product colors into multiple products instead of variants.

Prerequisite: Create a metaobject that can contain a list of products. For each group of sibling products, create an entry with the list of products. For each product, create a metafield that references the appropriate metaobject entry.

settings.info: Note: sibling swatches default to the first swatch in the product-level category metafield for 'Color'. When 'Color' is unset, the product title and product image will be used. Use these settings to override the default name or image, and for products where 'Color' cannot be set as a category metafield.
